traits.life_span.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): herbs annual, biennial or perennial; FOC the same, rarely suffrutescent.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 6 (2001), Silene (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): rarely plants suffrutescent; FNA: herbs, often with a branched caudex.

traits.stem_cross_section.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stems simple or branched, terete or sometimes angular.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): leaves opposite or occasionally whorled, joined at the base.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): blade linear to obovate or spatulate; FOC subulate, linear or lanceolate to ovate-lanceolate or elliptic. No usual state named, so the common shapes read as often.

traits.leaf_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): apex acute to obtuse.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal or sometimes axillary, simple or branched, sometimes condensed cymes, frequently few-flowered or solitary; FOC monochasium, dichasium, thyrse or flower solitary.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): inflorescences terminal or sometimes axillary.

traits.flower_merosity.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): calyx of 5 joined sepals (lobes) and petals 5.

traits.stamens.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens 10, rarely fewer or absent; FOC stamens 10.

traits.carpels.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): styles 3 or 5, occasionally 4; FOC styles 3 or 5 (one style per carpel).

traits.petal_apex.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): limb apex 2-lobed, sometimes dissected into 1-4 linear lobes or fimbriate, rarely entire. 'Entire' read as truncate, rarely, the nearest state.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules ovoid to globose, opening along sutures.

traits.capsule_valves.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): capsules open into 3-5 valves, frequently splitting into 6-10 equal teeth; FOC 6 or 10, rarely 5, teeth.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of North America vol. 5 (2005), Silene (Morton) (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): calyx tube frequently inflated; the family's sepals persist in fruit. In the inflated-calyx species the tube enlarges round the capsule (accrescent), as in S. vulgaris.
